newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures lower on long-liquidation.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures lower on long-liquidation.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower across the board on Wednesday, pressured by long-liquidation by private investors, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.6 yen to 2.0 yen per kg lower. Benchmark August was down 0.6 yen at 151.8 yen.
Activity was lacklustre. Trading was mainly spurred by technical factors amid a dearth of fresh factors.
"Charts suggest that the market is bearish on technical factors. Any rebound in prices is likely to be capped by long-liquidation," an analyst at a commodity broker said.
